basic_iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
basic_iron_sword.description: A standard three-foot blade. The weapon of a gentleman, but often wielded by scoundrels.

heavy_hammer.name: Meteor Hammer
heavy_hammer.description: A brutal chunk of iron on a handle. Crushes armor and finesse alike.

iron_staff.name: Iron Staff
iron_staff.description: A six-foot iron staff, favored by monks and wandering fighters for its defensive versatility.

hunting_bow.name: Hunting Bow
hunting_bow.description: A simple recurve bow for ranged combat. Less powerful than war bows but accurate in skilled hands.

poison_needle.name: Poison Needle
poison_needle.description: A slender steel needle barely visible in flight. Favored by the Tang Clan and shadow fighters.

bronze_saber.name: Bronze Saber
bronze_saber.description: A single-edged blade suited for fast, aggressive slashing techniques.

war_spear.name: War Spear
war_spear.description: A long-shafted spear designed for battlefield use. Keeps enemies at distance.

silk_fan.name: Iron-Ribbed Fan
silk_fan.description: A fan whose spine is reinforced with cold iron. Concealment is its greatest virtue.

jade_sword.name: Jade Frost Sword
jade_sword.description: A rare sword with a blade that faintly glows. Said to have been forged in a glacier. Conducts Qi beautifully.

hidden_darts.name: Flying Feather Darts
hidden_darts.description: A set of concealed throwing darts that can be launched in rapid succession.
